## Zero generation prompts, deliberately

**There are no open pantry slots in this reel, so there is
nothing to generate.** GATE F cannot distinguish "empty because
nobody wrote it" from "empty because there is nothing to write",
so this file states which one it is.

Every one of the 11 beats is `source: own (Remotion)` — a native
scene compiled from `beat_sheet.json`. No beat sources an image,

## REBUILD LAW

Product UI in this series is **recreated**, never screenshotted.
The captures in `../Suno Screenshots/` are reference for

Imagery inside recreated windows — feed tiles, moodboard
